name: Rook
greeting: Mind the corner. That sack has already had a worse journey than either of us.
lines: Kael: The wheel will need lifting before it can turn.
Rook: It will. The flour needed feeding to people before it needed feeding to mud.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A woman at the kitchen opens the sack and measures three small shares. She keeps the string for mending.

lines: Rook: There. Something went where we said it would. I could get used to that.
